summary: Redesigned the Browsing History page in the plain Project Explorer style with a filter box, page-type icons, and short, readable times.
details: Project Instances, My Workspace Folders, and Datasets are small labelled lists with a count.
Each row is one line: the page icon, the name, the path, and a time such as Today, 8:15 PM with the full timestamp on hover.
A filter box narrows every group by name or path at once.
A single click always opens a record; the first click on the page no longer gets lost.
The page follows the Dark and High Contrast themes through the shared theme colors.
